content: The spouses disputed the reimbursement of personal loans used for family needs and mortgage payments made after their split,. Applying Article 186, the court examined the presumption of joint liability for marital debts. The judge ruled that while pre-separation payments are presumed to come from common funds, any spouse who pays the full mortgage or loan installments after the legal separation is entitled to a 50% reimbursement from the other,. These credits were then offset against the property settlement.
